SELECT rd.botdetreg AS robot_id, rd.mfgnameval AS manufacturer, rd.modelseriesval AS model,
       ROUND((3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval)::numeric, 2) AS throughput_cycles_per_hour
FROM operation o
JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = o.operrecref
WHERE o.cycletimesecval > 0 AND 3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval < 180
ORDER BY throughput_cycles_per_hour ASC
LIMIT 5

WITH jt AS (
  SELECT jc.jcondoperref AS operreg, jc.jcdetref AS robot_id,
    (jc.joint_health->'J1'->>'temperature_C')::numeric t1,(jc.joint_health->'J2'->>'temperature_C')::numeric t2,
    (jc.joint_health->'J3'->>'temperature_C')::numeric t3,(jc.joint_health->'J4'->>'temperature_C')::numeric t4,
    (jc.joint_health->'J5'->>'temperature_C')::numeric t5,(jc.joint_health->'J6'->>'temperature_C')::numeric t6
  FROM joint_condition jc)
SELECT rd.botdetreg AS robot_id, rd.modelseriesval AS model,
  (1000.0/(mf.rulhours+1)) + (mf.faultpredscore*10) AS pmu_score,
  GREATEST(t1,t2,t3,t4,t5,t6) AS max_joint_temp
FROM maintenance_and_fault mf
JOIN jt ON jt.operreg = mf.upkeepoperation
JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = jt.robot_id
WHERE (1000.0/(mf.rulhours+1)) + (mf.faultpredscore*10) > 50
  AND ((t1+t2+t3+t4+t5+t6)/6 > 75 OR GREATEST(t1,t2,t3,t4,t5,t6) - LEAST(t1,t2,t3,t4,t5,t6) > 15)
ORDER BY pmu_score DESC, max_joint_temp DESC

WITH cs AS (
  SELECT o.operreg, rd.botdetreg AS robot_id, rd.mfgnameval AS manufacturer, rd.modelseriesval AS model,
         (sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval)/2.0 AS stress
  FROM system_controller sc
  JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = sc.systemoverseeroperation
  JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = o.operrecref
), cs2 AS (
  SELECT cs.*, AVG(stress) OVER (PARTITION BY model) AS model_avg FROM cs
), mw AS (
  SELECT jc.jcondoperref AS operreg,
    0.6*(SELECT AVG((v->>'vibration_mmps')::numeric) FROM jsonb_each(jc.joint_health) e(k,v))
  + 0.4*(SELECT AVG((v->>'backlash_deg')::numeric) FROM jsonb_each(jc.joint_health) e(k,v)) AS wear
  FROM joint_condition jc
)
SELECT cs2.robot_id, cs2.manufacturer, LOWER(cs2.model) AS model, cs2.stress AS controller_stress_score, mw.wear AS mechanical_wear_score
FROM cs2 JOIN mw ON mw.operreg = cs2.operreg
WHERE cs2.stress > 1.2*cs2.model_avg AND mw.wear >= 0.5
ORDER BY cs2.manufacturer, cs2.stress DESC

WITH cs AS (
  SELECT rd.botdetreg AS robot_id, rd.modelseriesval AS model,
         (sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval)/2.0 AS stress
  FROM system_controller sc
  JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = sc.systemoverseeroperation
  JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = o.operrecref
), cs2 AS (
  SELECT cs.*, AVG(stress) OVER (PARTITION BY model) AS model_avg_stress FROM cs
)
SELECT robot_id, LOWER(model) AS model, stress AS controller_stress_score, model_avg_stress
FROM cs2
WHERE stress > 1.2*model_avg_stress
ORDER BY controller_stress_score DESC, robot_id

SELECT rd.botdetreg AS robot_id, o.apptypeval AS application_type,
       a.poserrmmval / rd.reachmmval AS relative_positional_error,
       ps.calibstateval AS calibration_state
FROM actuation_data a
JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = a.actoperref
JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = a.actrecref
JOIN performance_and_safety ps ON ps.effectivenessactuation = a.actreg
WHERE o.apptypeval IN ('Assembly','Electronics-Handling','Inspection','Dispensing','Laser Cutting')
  AND a.poserrmmval / NULLIF(rd.reachmmval,0) > 0.0001
ORDER BY relative_positional_error DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT rd.botdetreg AS robot_id, rd.modelseriesval AS model, o.apptypeval,
         a.payloadwval / NULLIF(rd.payloadcapkg,0) AS payload_utilization_ratio,
         60.0 / o.cycletimesecval AS throughput_rate
  FROM operation o
  JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actoperref = o.operreg
  JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = o.operrecref
  WHERE o.cycletimesecval > 0
), q AS (
  SELECT base.*, NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY apptypeval ORDER BY throughput_rate DESC) AS quintile FROM base
)
SELECT robot_id, model, payload_utilization_ratio, throughput_rate
FROM q
WHERE quintile = 1 AND payload_utilization_ratio > 0.8
ORDER BY payload_utilization_ratio DESC, throughput_rate DESC

SELECT o.operrecref AS robot_id, mf.faultpredscore AS fault_prediction_score,
       mf.rulhours / 24.0 AS remaining_useful_life_days
FROM maintenance_and_fault mf
JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = mf.upkeepoperation
WHERE mf.rulhours / 24.0 < 7 AND mf.faultpredscore > 0.7
ORDER BY remaining_useful_life_days ASC, fault_prediction_score DESC

WITH hdr AS (
  SELECT rd.botdetreg, LOWER(rd.mfgnameval) AS manufacturer,
         (1.0 - ps.conditionindexval) / NULLIF(CURRENT_DATE - rd.instdateval, 0) AS hdr
  FROM performance_and_safety ps
  JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
)
SELECT manufacturer, COUNT(DISTINCT botdetreg) AS degrading_robot_count, AVG(hdr) AS avg_health_degradation_rate
FROM hdr
WHERE hdr > 0
GROUP BY manufacturer
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT botdetreg) > 1

WITH r AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN o.apptypeval IN ('Welding','Grinding','Deburring','Palletizing','Machine Tending')
              THEN 'High-Wear Applications' ELSE 'Other Applications' END AS application_group,
         CASE WHEN o.totopshrval / NULLIF(ps.emergencystopcount,0) < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS high_risk
  FROM performance_and_safety ps
  JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = ps.effectivenessactuation
  JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = a.actoperref
)
SELECT application_group, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(high_risk) / COUNT(*), 2) AS high_risk_percentage
FROM r
GROUP BY application_group

SELECT ROUND(AVG((j.value->>'vibration_mmps')::numeric), 2) AS fleet_avg_joint_vibration
FROM joint_condition jc
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(jc.joint_health) AS j
